verdict.rationale: GitCafe's docs index says issues can be tracked with milestones, so grouping issues into milestones is a documented first-party capability. That is only a single index-level mention, though, and nothing in the pack shows milestones carrying due dates. Missing for 10: evidence that milestones support due dates, a dedicated milestones guide on grouping and assigning issues, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can group issues into milestones with due dates

citations.quote: Track work with issues, pin and lock, labels and milestones.
